purpose: A D card on an NPN model is refused: a diode needs a diode model.

oracle.derivation: A D element names a D model (ngspice manual, Junction Diodes: DXXXX n+ n- mname, with .model mname D); qm is an NPN model. Xyce 7.10.0 exits 1 (netlist error at line 4); ngspice-44.2 and 45 exit 1 ("model type mismatch").
